pages.title: Superheated
pages.text:
**Superheated** is the stronger heat level of a Blaze Burner (the blue flame). Feed it a Blaze Cake, or pipe in Bioethanol, Peanut Oil or napalm. Some recipes need it.\
\
It counts as heated too, and makes twice the smog. Create Propulsion's burners can't superheat.
